item.title: Inside the Earl Teen Center: Where Baltimore teens learn, build and belong
item.description: The Earl Teen Center at the Enoch Pratt Free Library offers Baltimore youth a safe, supportive place to explore their interests after school. item.title: MD Public Defender’s Office unveils 2026 legislative priorities
item.description: Maryland’s Office of the Public Defender (MOPD) unveiled its 2026 legislative agenda at a Jan. 21 rally in Annapolis, Md., urging reforms to youth charging laws, traffic stops and indigent defense funding. Leaders cited racial disparities and systemic failures harming families and children statewide.
